name: Playfair Display and Lora
summary: A high-contrast display serif over a calm text serif, for narrative and long-form decks.
description: Playfair Display and Lora is a serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Playfair Display for headings with Lora for body text. Playfair Display's high stroke contrast reads as a headline at display sizes; Lora's moderate contrast and sturdy serifs keep paragraphs, quotes and table cells readable. Suits reports, cultural programs and narrative decks.
